堅定信心 銳志前行
Advancing with Confidence and Purpose

大新銀行集團以清晰視野與穩健步伐邁步前行，審慎不懈推動持續增長。憑藉穩固
根基與明確願景，我們以韌性及前瞻思維，沉著應對市場萬變與經濟不確定性。


Dah Sing Banking Group moves forward with clarity and strength, guided by
prudence and a commitment to sustainable growth. With solid fundamentals and
a clear vision, we navigate evolving market conditions and economic
uncertainties with resilience and foresight.

     風險管理及內部監控                  本集團亦透過現行之多項系統及程序，以識別、監控及
                                匯報本集團面對之主要風險。各業務及職能部門負責

                                評估其職責範圍內之風險，並根據風險管理程序管理
     意接納的風險性質及程度之負責，並確保本集團設立
                                相關風險及就風險管理提出報告。本集團透過設立專
     及維持合適及有效的風險管理及內部監控系統。該等
                                責管理委員會監督並監察主要風險範疇，以及就本集
     風險包括與環境、社會及管治以及氣候風險相關之重
                                團有關職能成立風險管理部門，維持有效之風險管理
     大風險。董事會並負責監督管理層對風險管理及內部
                                框架。
     監控系統的設計、實施及監察。管理層須就該等系統之
     有效性向董事會確認。
                                風險管理之報告會呈交予相關委員會，最後提呈董事
                                會或其授權之董事委員會以監督並監察與本集團業務
     集團之風險管理及內部監控系統旨在管理而非消除未
                                及運作相關之各種類風險。本集團之風險管理政策及
     能達成業務目標的風險，而且只能就不會有重大的失
                                主要監控權限，乃由董事會或其授權之委員會審批。運
     實陳述或損失作出合理而非絕對的保證。該等系統包
                                作及風險表現乃根據既定政策及程序，按相關風險限

                                度定期進行監察及檢討。

                                內部監控

     設定的程序旨在保障資產不被非授權挪用或處置；保    董事會授權管理層負責制訂及維持健全之內部監控制
     存恰當的會計記錄；以及確保用作業務及公告上的財    度。內部監控制度擬通過管理及營運監控、風險管理制
     務資料的可靠性。有關程序提供合理（而非絕對）的保   度架構之運作，使董事會可監察本集團之業務表現及
     證，以防出現嚴重的錯誤、損失或舞弊。亦設定程序以   財務狀況、監控及調節風險、採納健全之業務守則、合
     確保遵從適用之法律、規則及規例。           理�證對欺詐及誤差之監控、確保遵守適用法例及規
                                則，以及對管理人員作出監察及提供指引，以達成本公

Annual Assessment

The Group has implemented a robust risk management
and internal control framework with ongoing monitoring
and regular reporting of risk profiles, risk positions
and internal control issues to the Management and to
the Board. Based on the ongoing reviews and regular
assessments, the Management including the heads
of business units, financial control, risk management,
compliance units and operations management, and
the senior management of the key subsidiaries of the
Group have evaluated the existing status of the risk
management and internal control system and confirmed
that they remain effective with reference to the
requirements of the CG Code of the Listing Rules. These
statements of Management have been reviewed and
endorsed by Internal Audit function, and reviewed and
confirmed by senior management of the Group.

The results of the 2025 review, which have been reported
to the AC and the Board, concluded that the Groupʼs risk
management and internal control systems were effective
and adequate.

           （丁）共同控制實體               (d) Jointly controlled entities

           共同控制實體指本集團與其他人士以合        A joint venture is a contractual arrangement whereby the
           約協議方式共同進行經濟活動，該活動        Group and other parties undertake an economic activity,

乃確認為撥備。然而，包含貸款及未提取承        allowance is recognised as a provision. However, for contracts

      或然負債指因為過往事件而可能引起之承     A contingent liability is a possible obligation that arises from
      擔，而其存在只能就集團控制範圍以外之一    past events and whose existence will only be confirmed by the
      宗或多宗不確定未來事件之出現而被確認。    occurrence or non-occurrence of one or more uncertain future
      或然負債亦可能是因為過往事件引致之現有    events not wholly within the control of the Group. It can also be a
      承擔，但由於可能不需要有經濟資源流失，或   present obligation arising from past events that is not recognised

      附註中披露。假若資源流失之可能性改變而    to the consolidated financial statements. When a change in the
      導致資源可能流失，則被確認為撥備。      probability of an outflow occurs so that outflow is probable, it will
                             then be recognised as a provision.

      產，而其存在只能就集團控制範圍以外之一    and whose existence will be confirmed only by the occurrence or
      宗或多宗不確定事件之出現而被確認。      non-occurrence of one or more uncertain events not wholly within
                             the control of the Group.

      能獲得時在綜合財務報表附註中披露。若實    the consolidated financial statements when an inflow of economic
      質確定有收益獲得時，則被確認為資產。     benefits is probable. When such inflow is virtually certain, an asset
                             is recognised.

      後配以殘活可能性作出調整（即該風險承擔於         the likelihood of survival (i.e. the exposure has not prepaid or
      早前月分並未提早還款或違約）。其有效計算         defaulted in an earlier month). This effectively calculates an ECL for
      未來各月份之預期信貸虧損，然後再貼現至          each future month, which is then discounted back to the reporting
      呈報日及匯總。用於計算預期信貸虧損之貼          date and summed. The discount rate used in the ECL calculation is
      現率乃原有之實際利率或其約數。              the original effective interest rate or an approximation thereof.

      全期違約或然率乃應用到期日分布至即期12         The Lifetime PD is developed by applying a maturity profile to the
      個月期間而得。到期日分布檢視組合自初始          current 12M PD. The maturity profile looks at how defaults develop
      確認起至貸款期內如何形成違約。到期日分          on a portfolio from the point of initial recognition throughout the
      布根據過往可見數據及假定組合及信貨級別          lifetime of the loans. The maturity profile is based on historical
      段內之所有資產皆相同。其受到過往分析所          observed data and is assumed to be the same across all assets
      支持。                          within a portfolio and credit grade band. This is supported by
                                   historical analysis.

      3.3 市場風險                 3.3 Market risk

      市場風險乃指由市場上利率及價格不利變化      Market risk is the risk of losses in assets, liabilities and off-balance
      而引致對資產、負債及資產負債表外持倉之      sheet positions arising from adverse movements in market rates
      虧損風險。                    and prices.

      各類交易之市場風險均由董事會、風險管理      Market risk exposure for different types of transactions is managed
      及合規委員會及財資及投資風險委員會按       within various risk limits and guidelines approved by the Board,
      董事會授予之權力所核准之各項風險限額及      the RMCC and the TIRC under the authority delegated from
      指引內處理。風險限額按組合層面以及各產      the Board. Risk limits are set at the portfolio level as well as by
      品及不同風險類別設定。該等限額綜合包含      products and by different types of risks. The risk limits comprise
      了名義金額、止蝕限額、敏感度及運用風險值     a combination of notional, stop-loss, sensitivity and value-at-risk
      （
      「風險值」）之監控。所有涉及市場風險的交     (“VaR”) controls. All trading positions are subject to daily mark-to-
      易持倉需要每日按市值入賬。集團風險部之      market valuation. The Risk Management and Control Department
      風險管理及監控部（「風險管理及監控部」
                        ）乃     (“RMCD”) within the GRD, as an independent risk management
      一個獨立之風險管理及控制部門，負責比較      and control unit, identifies, measures, monitors and controls the
      風險和已審批限額，以識別、計量、監控及管     risk exposures against approved limits and initiates specific actions
      理該等風險及提議具體行動去確保持倉被限      to ensure positions are managed within an acceptable level. Any
      制在可接受水平內。任何不符合限額情況均      exceptions have to be reviewed and sanctioned by the appropriate
      須依據有關政策及程序經合適管理層－財資      level of management of TIRC, RMCC or the Board as stipulated in
      及投資風險委員會，風險管理及合規委員會      the relevant policies and procedures.
      或董事會審查及批准。

      大新銀行有限公司（ 「大新銀行」）之附屬公司   Banco Comercial de Macau, S.A. (“BCM”) and Dah Sing Bank
      澳門商業銀行股份有限公司（「澳門商業銀      (China) Limited (“DSB China”), which are subsidiaries of Dah
      行」）及大新銀行（中國）有限公司（「大新銀行   Sing Bank, Limited (“DSB”), run their treasury functions locally
      （中國）」）根據其一套自定限額和政策及在大    under their own set of limits and policies and within the market
      新銀行設定之市場風險管理框架內執行其本      risk management framework set by DSB. The RMCD of DSB

           框架。董事會授權財資及投資風險委員                                              governance and control processes of the Group. It delegates

           險管理及監控部和獨立專業合資格估值                                              financial instruments to the TIRC. Valuation is performed
           師（如適用）獨立地進行，而估值結果乃                                             independently by RMCD and where appropriate, by
           定期驗證，確保公平值計量過程之完整                                              independent and professionally qualified valuers and the
           性。                                                             valuation results are periodically verified to ensure the
                                                                          integrity of the fair value measurement process.

           金融工具之公平值乃在目前市場情況下                                              The fair value of financial instruments is the price that would
           市場參與者於計量日進行之有序交易中                                              be received to sell an asset or paid to transfer a liability
           出售資產所收取或轉移負債所支付之價                                              in an orderly transaction between market participants at
           格，不論該價格為直接可觀察或使用估                                              the measurement date under current market conditions
           值方法估計。                                                         regardless of whether that price is directly observable or
                                                                          estimated using a valuation technique.

      本集團於2025年及2024年12月31日為投資物業   The Group's investment properties were last revalued at 31
      的價值進行了重估。此評估由獨立專業特許          December 2025 and 2024 by adopting the direct comparison
      測量師第一太平戴維斯（估值及專業顧問）有         approach or the income capitalisation approach. Under
      限公司為位於香港及中國國內之投資物業及          direct comparison approach, valuation is referenced to recent
      第一太平戴維斯（澳門）有限公司為位於澳門         transactions for similar premises as far as practicable by
      之投資物業按直接比較方法或收入現值資產          independent, professionally qualified valuer Savills (Valuation
      化方法以可參考之相似物業其近期成交紀錄          and Professional Services) Limited for investment properties in
      來進行。在評定投資物業的價值時，其中一項         Hong Kong and Chinese Mainland, and by Savills (Macau) Limited
      主要依據為經考慮時間、地點及個別因素如          for investment properties in Macau. The key inputs was the unit
      樓宇的大小及樓層所確定的銷售單位價格。          sale rate taking into account of time, location, and individual
      銷售單位價格的下降會導致投資物業之公平          factors such as size and levels of buildings. A decrease in unit sale
      值計量有相應百分比的減少，反之亦然。           rate would result in decrease in fair value measurement of the
                                   investment properties by the same percentage and vice versa.

      市場價值為物業之估值基礎，其與香港財務          The basis of the valuation of property was market value which is
      報告準則第13號《公平值計量》中之公平值定        consistent with the definition of fair value under HKFRS 13 “Fair
      義一致及已計入就市場參與者而言之最高和          Value Measurement” and takes into account the highest and best
      最佳的物業用途。                     use of the property from the perspective of market participants.

      投資物業以大部份不可觀察之數據運用估值          Investment properties are measured at fair value using valuation
      方法計量公平值，其被分類至被界定為香港          techniques with significant unobservable inputs which are

      等級的第3級別。                     HKFRS 13, “Fair Value Measurement”.

      業，有關之評估按淨收入現值資產化及經考          which the fair value is determined on the basis of capitalisation of
      慮該等物業之支出與其可復歸收入之潛力進          net incomes with due allowance for outgoings and reversionary
      行。公平值計量與市場租金成正相關關係，與         income potential. The fair value measurement is positively
      市場收益率成負相關關係。                 correlated to the market rental and inversely correlated to the

      總體淨額結算安排                            Master netting arrangements

      本集團會盡可能與交易對手訂立總體淨額結                 To mitigate credit risks, the Group enters into master netting
      算安排，以減低信貸風險。淨額結算協議規                 arrangements with counterparties whenever possible. Netting
      定，一旦出現違約事件，所有涉及交易對手之                agreements provide that, if an event of default occurs, all
      未完成交易均會終止，而所有結欠款項將拼                 outstanding transactions with the counterparty will be terminated
      合按淨額結算。如非發生違約事件，所有與對                and all amounts outstanding will be settled on a net basis. Except
      手之交易會以總額結算及一般不會在綜合財                 for the event of default, all outstanding transactions with the
      務狀況表中對銷資產及負債。                       counterparty are settled on a gross basis and generally do not
                                          result in offsetting the assets and liabilities in the consolidated
                                          statement of financial position.
